role_description: Frontend developer with eight years of experience building and maintaining web applications in React and TypeScript. Most at home in a design system: shared components, accessibility, and the test coverage that lets a team change them without fear.

experience.title: Senior Frontend Developer
highlights: Led the rebuild of a customer portal in Next.js, cutting first-load time from 4.1s to 1.3s on mid-range mobile hardware.
Introduced a shared component library used by four product teams, replacing three divergent sets of form controls.
Raised end-to-end coverage of the checkout path from 20% to 85% with Playwright, catching two regressions before release.
Mentored three junior developers through code review and paired debugging sessions.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
highlights: Migrated a class-based React codebase to hooks in stages, keeping the application shippable throughout.
Built an accessible product filtering interface audited against WCAG 2.1 AA.
Worked with designers to turn an ad-hoc style sheet into a documented token set.

experience.title: Frontend Developer
highlights: Developed internal dashboards for reporting, handling tens of thousands of rows with virtualised tables.
Added a GraphQL data layer that replaced six ad-hoc REST endpoints.
Set up the team's first CI pipeline for linting, type checking, and unit tests.

experience.title: Junior Frontend Developer
highlights: Implemented responsive marketing pages from Figma designs.
Took part in code review and estimation as part of a five-person Scrum team.
